summary:
We developed AgroVision AI, a smart agriculture platform that uses NASA satellite data, AI, and soil information to help farmers make better decisions.  
 It analyzes soil conditions, satellite images, and crop health to help farmers choose suitable crops and make smarter crop rotation decisions.   
It helps farmers save resources, improve productivity, protect soil health, and build a more sustainable future for agriculture.
details:
AgroVision AI is an AI-powered agriculture platform that combines NASA satellite data, soil information, and crop analysis to help farmers make smarter decisions.

It analyzes soil and environmental conditions, monitors crop health, and suggests suitable crops and crop rotation options.

Our project helps save water, improve productivity, protect soil health, and support sustainable farming.

We developed it using Python, FastAPI, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and NASA Earth observation data.

Our innovation is combining satellite technology and AI to turn complex agricultural data into simple, useful recommendations for farmers.

We focused on soil quality, climate, water availability, crop needs, and farmers' real challenges.
